summary: Slateport forward checkpoint contained a hidden Bag task that rejected movement
symptom: RAM showed the verified full-health Slateport party and map, but an active Key Items Bag task owned input while the canonical observation reported overworld and navigation directions produced no coordinate delta.

unexpected.predicted: A saved post-preparation checkpoint should leave the field input owner in clean overworld state and a route request should move the player.
unexpected.actual: The checkpoint had an active verified Bag task (pocket 4, mode 8) with field_message_box_mode 0; DOWN completed as an RPC action but map position stayed (10,2).
diff: active Bag task owned input while field_message_box_mode remained 0
navigation action acknowledged done without changing map position

authority.oracle: RAM task payload, field UI flags, map coordinates, and unchanged party species/HP/moves before and after cleanup
sources: RunBunAdapter.observe with tasks=True and the verified Bag cursor payload
live cleanup result: two B actions removed Bag/Start layers with map and party unchanged

steps: load the hashed fixture in a muted disposable clone
observe canonical map, mode, field_bag_open, and battle_active without input
reproduction.observed: Both runs reported map 9:11 at (10,2), mode overworld, battle inactive, and field_bag_open=true.

hypotheses.claim: The navigation actuator ignored movement because the Bag task, not overworld movement, owned the input queue.
hypotheses.discriminator: The fixed task-payload decoder reports field_bag_open=true on two identical fixture replays while map and party remain unchanged.
evidence_against: Route 110 clone movement from a clean overworld state changed position

root_cause.claim: The canonical observation omitted a verified Bag-task ownership flag, so navigation treated a hidden Key Items menu as clean overworld and sent directions into the wrong input owner.
evidence: The fixture task has the stable Bag payload: data[1]=512, data[3]=2077, data[4]=51445, data[5]=2077, pocket=4, menu mode=8.
The same fixture reports field_bag_open=true on two deterministic clone runs after the fix.
The live B-only cleanup closed two UI layers and preserved map, party species, HP, and moves.
alternatives_falsified: Route geometry was not the cause: the decoded live path to the target had length 9.
The RPC action was not merely unfinished: it returned done and advanced frames while the map stayed fixed.
A global movement failure was not present: a clean Route 110 fixture moved from (15,89) to (16,89).

solution.contract_change: RunBunAdapter.observe exposes ui.field_bag_open and follow_route refuses battle or field-menu ownership before sending any direction; close_field_bag performs bounded B-only cleanup with postconditions.
solution.workaround: Use close_field_bag only after field_bag_open is verified; never send route input into a field UI.

targeted_checks.name: Bag task decoder and navigation guard tests
Live B-only cleanup postcondition
targeted_checks.command: RunBunAdapter.close_field_bag on the preserved live state
targeted_checks.evidence: 2 layers closed; map 9:11 (10,2), party species [388,397,231,878,551,111], HP and moves unchanged; field_bag_open=false

regression_checks.name: Relevant Run & Bun regression suite
regression_checks.command: python3 -m unittest tests.test_runbun tests.test_battle_policy_runner tests.test_battle_policy tests.test_capabilities tests.test_trainer_database

replay.expected: The hashed fixture reports field_bag_open=true and no battle without sending input.
replay.actual: Both deterministic clone runs reported field_bag_open=true, map 9:11 at (10,2), and battle inactive.

domain_knowledge: A Run & Bun Bag task can own input while field_message_box_mode is 0; task payload is authoritative for hidden Bag detection.
regression_cases: runtime/session/incident-slateport-stale-bag-20260809.state: two-run hidden Bag observation and no-input navigation guard
tooling_contracts: Navigation must inspect field UI ownership and refuse to send directions unless clean overworld input ownership is verified.
